senses.gloss:
भित्तं [भिद्-क्त नि˚ तस्य न नः]
1 A
part, portion.
--2 A fragment, bit.
--3 A wall, partition.

भित्ति f. [भिद्-क्तिन्]
1 Breaking,
splitting; dividing.
--2 A wall,
partition; समया सौधभित्तिं Dk.;
Śi. 4. 67.
--3 (Hence) Any place, spot
or ground (आश्रय) to work anything
upon; चित्रकर्मरचना भित्तिं विना वर्तते
Mu. 2. 4.
--4 A fragment, bit, piece,
portion.
--5 Anything broken.
--6
A rent, fissure.
--7 A mat.
--8 A
flaw, defect.
--9 An opportunity.
--Comp.
--खातनः a rat.
--चौरः a
house-breaker.
--पातनः {1} a kind
of rat. {2} a rat.

1 A wall, partition.
--2
A small house-lizard.

भीत p. p. [भी-क्त]
1 Frightened,
terrified, alarmed, afraid of (with
abl.); न भीतो मरणादस्मि Mk. 10. 27.
--2
Fearful, timid.
--3 Placed in
danger, imperiled.
--तं Fear, dread.
--तं
ind. Timidly.
--Comp.
--भीत a.
exceedingly afraid.

भीतंकार^1 a. Making(one) afraid.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20170203. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/335. note: adjective.

भीतिः f. [भी-क्तिन्]
1 Fear,
apprehension, dread, terror; न भेजिरे
भीमविषेण भीतिं Bh. 2. 80.
--2 Shaking.
tremour.
--3 Danger, risk.
--Comp.
--नाटितकं a gesticulation or
representation of fear.
